worker_summary.analysis_summary: Phase 2 revision (round 2) of hostinger-reach v1.4.4. HR-001 is confirmed TP with strengthened evidence: the nonce localization in enqueue_assets() fires on every frontend page request when OptInMonster integration is active (init hook → trigger_active_integrations → init_active_integration → active_integration_hooks → enqueue_assets → wp_localize_script), and the hook dispatch terminal do_action('hostinger_reach_submit') has a concrete state-changing consumer (ReachApiHandler::post_contact hooked in ReachApiHandler::init()). HR-002 retains REVIEW with field corrections per reviewer guidance: entry point corrected to AddFormNotice.php:28, impact narrowed to notice-transient dismissal and fixed redirect URL, subscriber escalation framing removed. FP findings HR-FP-001 through HR-FP-007 carry forward with field corrections per reviewer: anchor alignments corrected, auth boundaries tightened, XSS sink labels removed where only boolean guard logic was shown.

worker_findings.vuln_type: Broken Access Control — Unauthenticated REST endpoint accepts contact injection via guest-obtainable wp_rest nonce (OptInMonster integration)
Missing capability check on authenticated AJAX notice-dismiss action (AddFormNotice)
False positive: intentionally public GET /integrations route with only low-sensitivity integration inventory/status disclosure
False positive: POST /contact is an intentionally public subscription form endpoint with nonce and connection-status guard
False positive: SatisfactionSurvey::is_hostinger_page() inspects $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] only to compute a boolean survey-load condition
False positive: boolean helper methods read server environment flags; no packet-local XSS sink shown
False positive: admin-only POST /integrations writes only whitelisted integration state to the fixed hostinger_reach_integrations option
False positive: WooCommerceIntegration::get_contacts() SQL query uses hardcoded table name and integer-parameterized pagination only
False positive: semgrep-flagged lines in handler and integration files are boolean guards, REST response delegation, or admin-gated persistence operations — no HTML output sink
